facts.fact: The Tanzania Communications Regulatory Authority suspended the online content licence of Vapper Tech Limited (JamiiForums) for 90 days from 6 September 2025 over content it called misleading and insulting to the Government and the President, under the Online Content Regulations 2020, 2022 and 2025; it did not disclose the specific content.
The TCRA notice states it blocked access to the JamiiForums platform when it suspended the licence on 6 September 2025, for 90 days.
